bullets: Jose Mourinho is the new league leader, taking over the top spot from Higginzinho with 397 points after posting the week's highest score of 69.
Set Piece FC ⛳️⚽️ had the week's lowest score, 28 points, and it was also the biggest faller, dropping 4 places to 18th on 308 total.
Andrageddon was the biggest riser, up 4 places to 11th on 327 total points after a 51-point gameweek.
Haaland remained the most captained pick, worn by 20 of 23 managers, but returned just 6 points.
The highest scoring player owned in the league was Semenyo with 17 points.
Two chips were played this week: Full Metal Jacquet used Free Hit for 40 points, and Don Julio used Wildcard for 41 points.
FASI Stars sits 2nd on 384 and Higginzinho slipped to 3rd on 376 as the top of the table reshuffled.
10 transfers were made across the league this week, with 2 teams still yet to make a single transfer all season.
